option: Migrate the production database cluster from self-managed PostgreSQL on EC2 to a managed RDS/Aurora offering

costs.item: Migration engineering effort (6 weeks, 3 engineers @ $150/hr blended)
Managed service premium over self-hosted (annual, first year)

benefits.item: Reduced on-call incident hours (est. 120 hrs/yr saved @ $150/hr)
Infrastructure savings from managed autoscaling and reserved capacity

recommendation: Total costs are $165,000 ($108,000 + $42,000 + $15,000), against total first-year benefits of $80,000/year ($18,000 + $25,000 + $37,000). At $80,000/year recurring, payback is $165,000 / $80,000 ≈ 2.1 years, and the 3-year ROI is (3×$80,000 − $165,000) / $165,000 ≈ 45.5%. Recommend proceeding: the migration pays for itself within roughly two years and continues generating $80,000/year in savings and reduced on-call burden thereafter.
